OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

## What I changed

The feature: `POST /api/owners` accepts an optional `registrationDate`; when omitted the server defaults it to today, and it's returned as an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` string.

- **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `registrationDate` (`type: string, format: date`) to the shared `OwnerFields` schema, so it's both accepted on input and echoed on output. The generator produces a `LocalDate` DTO field, which Jackson serializes as `YYYY-MM-DD`, and MapStruct maps it automatically (no mapper edits).
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `registrationDate` `LocalDate` field with a plain getter/setter and a `@PrePersist` hook that defaults it to `LocalDate.now()` only when null (so a supplied date is preserved and the default is persisted at registration time).
- **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** + **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — added the `registration_date DATE` column (the test profile uses `ddl-auto=none`) and extended the positional seed inserts to match.
- **`db/h2`, `db/postgres`, `db/mysql` schemas** — added the same column so the other supported profiles keep working (their seed inserts use named columns, so no data changes were needed there).

## Structural-impact notes

- No existing method was modified — the controller, service, and mapper are untouched. The default logic lives in one tiny new `@PrePersist` method (CC 2), and the new accessors are CC 1, so the per-function cost stays minimal.
- MapStruct auto-mapping meant the mapper interface didn't need editing, avoiding cost in a class with derived-field expressions.
- The Java change is confined to a single file (`Owner.java`); the rest are declarative SQL/YAML.
